lean.fidelity_note: The paper fixes the zero-mean Poisson pressure and normalizes $\max_{[t_0,T]}|\mathbf a(t,0)|=\lambda^{-3/4}$. The formal statement allows any smooth periodic parent pressure satisfying the stated residual and coercivity conditions, and requires only $0<|\mathbf a(t,0)|\le\lambda^{-3/4}$. All regularity, symmetry, incompressibility, and residual assertions in (5.46)–(5.48) are retained, including the exact term $\|\widetilde\chi^{\prime}\gamma\|_\infty$ on the activation interval. Uniform bounds at each time express the time suprema, and Hölder regularity is concluded explicitly. After fixing the envelope exponent, the formal statement chooses thresholds for $b$ and $\Gamma_P$, and constants $C_{m,P}$, before the parent. It then permits any sufficiently large $b$ and $\Gamma_P$ satisfying the common smallness condition; the order constants do not change with these enlargements. The coefficient $\Gamma_P$ may depend on depth, and every admissible expansion receives the estimates on the whole interval.
